MonthDetail.description: Everything the month view shows, on the shared aggregates definitions.

MonthlySummary.title: MonthlySummary

RecalculateRead.description: What a local recalculation changed. No bank request and no LLM.
RecalculateRead.title: RecalculateRead

RecurringChargeCreate.description: Mark a transaction's merchant as recurring (confirmed) at the given cadence.
RecurringChargeCreate.title: RecurringChargeCreate

RuleCreate.title: RuleCreate

RulePreview.description: A rule to count matches for; nothing is saved.
RulePreview.title: RulePreview

RulePreviewRead.description: How many existing transactions a rule would match.
RulePreviewRead.title: RulePreviewRead

RuleSuggestion.description: Defaults for a new rule built from a transaction.
RuleSuggestion.title: RuleSuggestion

RuleUpdate.description: Changes to a rule; fields left out keep their value. The rule is re-applied to existing transactions.
RuleUpdate.title: RuleUpdate

TransactionRuleRead.description: The rule that matches a transaction, if any, and defaults for a new one.

TransactionSummary.description: Totals for every transaction the filters match, not one page.

TransactionUpdate.title: TransactionUpdate

post.description: Ask the LLM for new savings suggestions from aggregates only.
Re-apply rules to non-manual categorizations, categorize from the merchant cache, and detect recurring charges. No bank request and no LLM.
Mark a transaction's merchant as a confirmed recurring charge.

get.description: Up to seven items; `all=true` returns every item so the card can expand in place.
One month in detail: totals vs recent average, essentiality, categories, largest.

post.description: Upserts by match type and pattern, then applies the rule to existing transactions.
Counts the non-transfer transactions a rule would match and how many of them were set by hand, which a rule leaves as they are. Saves nothing.

patch.description: Changes a rule, then re-applies it to existing transactions. Transactions the old rule matched and the new one does not keep their category.

post.description: Exchange a SimpleFIN setup token for an access URL and store it encrypted.
Start a manual sync in the background. Poll the returned run for status.

get.description: When the next scheduled sync will run (before a few minutes of jitter).
Count and posted sums for every transaction the list filters match. Pending rows are counted (pending_count) but are in neither sum; transfers are excluded unless include_transfers.

delete.description: Delete a pending transaction that never became a charge. 409 for a posted transaction.

post.description: A pending transaction the bank will not return again becomes posted, so it counts in totals. A later sync sets it back to pending only if the bank returns it as pending. 409 for a posted transaction.

get.description: The rule that categorizes this transaction, with categorization's precedence (exact, contains, prefix), or null; and defaults for a new rule.

post.description: Split a transfer pair: both rows count as ordinary transactions again, and later syncs leave them unpaired.
